claims.claim: Google Posts appear near reviews on the local panel
claims.note: Original draft claimed a specific, dated algorithm change ('this fall... jumped higher'), which is unverifiable and effectively a fabricated news hook. Rewritten as an observable placement pattern any reader can check on their own profile.

claims.claim: Most service-business profiles haven't posted in months
claims.note: Common, widely observed pattern in local service GBP audits; presented as a general tendency, not a sourced statistic.
